question: The factors of the polynomial x² - 9x + 18 are:
solution:
Given:

The polynomial is x2 - 9x + 18.

Calculation:

For the polynomial x2 - 9x + 18, we need to find factors of 18 that add up to -9.

Numbers are -3 and -6.

So, we can write:

x2 - 9x + 18 = x2 - 3x - 6x + 18

⇒ x(x - 3) - 6(x - 3)

⇒ (x - 3)(x - 6)

The factors of the polynomial x2 - 9x + 18 are (x - 3) and (x - 6).
